other_engines.note: No free keyless index-status API exists for Bing or Yandex. Bing Webmaster Tools has one (GET /webmaster/api.svc/json/GetUrlTrafficInfo etc.) but it needs an API key from a signed-in account, which is a human step; Yandex Webmaster likewise needs OAuth. Neither key exists in this repo, so those channels are reported UNMEASURED.
other_engines.bing: UNMEASURED — the positive control returned 0 results on a domain that is certainly indexed (HTTP 200), so this probe cannot see the index at all. A zero for our host would be a broken probe, not an absent site.

movement.note: This run minus the census in data/indexation.json before it was overwritten. The discovered/unknown split is known to be noisy between runs; in_google_index and ever_crawled_by_google are the stable pair.

split_stability.why: The predecessor recorded that the discovered/unknown split moved between runs and called it approximate. This run quantifies it: two full 141-URL censuses were taken 15 minutes apart on the same day with the same key, and their per-URL coverage_state was compared.
split_stability.verdict: The discovered/unknown split is NOT a measurement. 82 of 141 URLs (58 percent) answered differently 15 minutes apart. Only in_google_index and ever_crawled_by_google were stable across both passes, and both were 1. Do not track the split between rounds.
